evidence_contract.development: identify each domain's critical-function coefficients only from development seeds
evidence_contract.freeze: hash contract and fitted coefficients before confirmation
evidence_contract.confirmation: run new seeds without changing coefficients, thresholds, dynamics or endpoints
evidence_contract.pairing: reuse identical initial states and exogenous innovations across policies within each condition
evidence_contract.negative_results: retain every condition and report induced as well as prevented failures

claim_boundary: Author-defined heterogeneous computational counterparts constrained by the qualitative ranges of retained public records. They are neither source-controller replay, HIL, hardware experiments nor counterfactuals extracted from passive logs.
